statement: Pinned Dolphin's MotionPlus emulator places a 32-byte calibration block at register offset 0x20, with separate 13-byte fast and slow gyro blocks containing yaw/roll/pitch zero offsets, axis scale factors and a unit scale byte, each followed by a UID byte and a 16-bit portion of one CRC32. Dolphin calculates CRC32 across the first 14 bytes and bytes 16-29, then stores its high/low halves in the two designated 16-bit checksum fields. This describes emulator-generated calibration, not real captured sensor data or factory defaults.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: MotionPlus.h 29-70, 186-197; MotionPlus.cpp 109-153. Source-emulator CRC algorithm and register layout, not direct hardware verification.
